method: integer coefficient convolutions; first strict descent scans through the final positive coefficient with zero extension

bounded_scope.p_scope: all integer p with x+2<=p and 3p<2alpha+1

complete_eligible_witness.vertex_encoding: vertices 0..18; root 0; arm i has vertices (a_i,b_i,c_i)=(1+3i,2+3i,3+3i), with edges (0,a_i),(a_i,b_i),(b_i,c_i), for i=0..5

limitations: Finite range does not prove x(P)>=m for all m.
The exact computations do not prove that every eligible leaf is favorable for all m.
No general non-star rooted-branch theorem follows from this family census.
